notes: SR10 is definitional: literal-1/identifier-1 is the sending operand, identifier-3 the receiving operand. The binder binds each stringSendingPhrase operand through the SENDING resolver (StrUnstrOperand -> FieldOperand / LiteralOperand / FigurativeOperand / function-identifier) and identifier-3 and identifier-4 through ExpressionBinder.ResolveReceiving (the receiving chokepoint - a constant-name or function-identifier INTO is refused there). Consistent with the grammar (stringIntoPhrase : INTO dataReference). No behavior of its own to test.
